text_block_list.text:
After training concluded, I spotted an 
Umamusume looking troubled...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Running with strength... No, that's not 
it. Have fun... do my best... Ugh, this 
isn't working.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Um... they said they want to feature a 
special article on me in the academy 
magazine...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've always been no good at that sort of 
thing…… I was agonizing over how to 
answer.
choice_data_list: Why not demonstrate the training yourself?

Let's try overcoming it little by little 
if you're not good at it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, there's no need to 
explain it with words.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I've decided to give it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right... Just because I'm bad at it 
doesn't mean I can keep running away.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: However, what on earth should I do...?
choice_data_list: Why not prepare some notes before you go?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see... In that case, we might just be 
able to manage somehow.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll do my best to make it 
work.
